capabilities: Suggest tags, aliases, and a summary for the current note using an AI provider
Review and edit suggestions in a modal before applying them
Batch process a folder, opening the review modal per note
Configure any OpenAI-compatible endpoint with presets for OpenAI, Ollama, and OpenRouter
Control what is sent to the API via excluded folders, code-block stripping, and content length limits
extras: Setup requires building from source (npm install && npm run build) and copying the folder into .obsidian/plugins/. The README notes that truncated note content is sent to the configured API endpoint, recommending a local Ollama model for full privacy.
problem: Filling in frontmatter metadata like tags, aliases, and summaries by hand is tedious, and Obsidian has no built-in way to generate them from note content.

relations.evidence: Configurable OpenAI-compatible endpoint with quick presets (OpenAI, Ollama, OpenRouter)
